question: Who among the following singers has received the Dadasaheb Phalke Award?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Asha Bhosle**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Legendary **Bollywood playback singer Asha Bhosle has entered the Guinness World Records for the most number of single studio recordings.
 
• She is best known for her playback singing in Hindi cinema.
